spec.name: home near token 1 then insert
spec.notes: One rule change: the early far-predecessor X becomes a home-L when r0=0 and token 1 lies in the near half. pos1 falls each step, so no cycle. Once token 1 is at the front, the existing XL/RX insertion and csorted finish are unchanged. Aimed at m8r3 states that otherwise set r0=2 and carry token 1 the long way.
